entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • blazor.web.js missing on .net9 app using .net10 sdk #65353
  • InvalidCastException when using [AsParameters] with primary constructor record that has ValidationAttribute on constructor parameters #65348
  • The fwlink for https://aka.ms/aspnetcore/11.0-third-party-notices is incorrect #65347
  • RequestDelegateGenerator enabled results in incorrect ApiParameterDescription.IsRequired for nullable array #65344

Closed

  • Perf regression: json #65346
  • Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Server doesn't work when building runtime linux-arm64 #65230
  • Blazor WebAssembly Custom Elements load resources from wrong origin after updating to .NET 10 #65156
  • PersistentState crash the app if SignalR message size limit is hit #65101

PullRequests

Created

  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 1159: Build ID 2897386 #65354
    area-mvc

    area-blazor
  • Use pre-allocated static responses for fast-path bad request handling #65345
    Perf, area-networking
